name: AIRFIELD ASSAULT
situation_report: An enemy airfield lies lightly defended. A bold raid could destroy aircraft on the ground and cripple enemy air operations. Your forces must strike fast, destroy as much as possible, and withdraw before enemy reinforcements arrive from the main base.
tactical_context: This is a raid, not an occupation. Speed is essential. Destroy high-value targets (aircraft, fuel) quickly and get out. Don't get bogged down or you'll be trapped when reinforcements arrive.

terrain_features.name: Desert Airstrip
terrain_features.description: Cleared runway with fuel dumps and aircraft dispersals
terrain_features.special_rules: Open ground. Aircraft and fuel dumps are objectives/targets.

terrain_features.name: Hangar/Control Tower
terrain_features.special_rules: Hard cover. May be fortified by defender.

terrain_features.name: Fuel Dump
terrain_features.special_rules: Soft cover. Explodes if destroyed (pinning within 10").

terrain_notes: Open airfield with parked aircraft and fuel as primary targets
victory_conditions:
**Attacker Major Victory**: Destroy 3+ aircraft AND fuel dump AND withdraw by turn 6.

**Attacker Minor Victory**: Destroy 2+ aircraft or fuel dump AND withdraw.

**Defender Victory**: Prevent destruction of aircraft OR trap attacker (don't let them withdraw).

**Draw**: Heavy damage but both sides depleted.
deployment_steps: Place airfield runway in table center
Place 3-4 aircraft at dispersals around runway
Place fuel dump, hangar, control tower
Defender deploys light garrison (50% points) within 12" of runway
Attacker deploys entire force in deployment zone

special_rules: May need to withdraw before reinforcements arrive
Light garrison forces (50% of attacker points)

objectives.spacing_rules: 3-4 aircraft + fuel dump + control tower = 5 objectives

special_rules: On a 4+, reinforcements arrive from reserve edge
Maximum 1/3 of force may arrive per turn
Reinforcements are base reaction force arriving from North edge
**Aircraft Targets**: Each aircraft destroyed = 1 objective. Armor 0, any hit destroys.
**Fuel Dump**: Explodes on destruction (all units within 10" must pass pinning test)
**Control Tower**: Capturing control tower = 1 objective (must have unit in base)
**Time Limit**: Attacker must withdraw by turn 6 or face overwhelming reinforcements
**Surprise Raid**: Attacker gets +1 to hit on turn 1 only
**Light Garrison**: Defender starts with 50% points, reinforcements 50% arrive turn 3+
